photos.notes: Independent full physical front held against blue background. All corners visible; useful left art, upper-right background and border striae. Lower ball/textbox still dark; does not establish complete relief.
Full physical front held in hand; upper engraving, silver border and large lower Master Ball. Lower dark areas need complementary illumination.
Same specimen tilted into directional light. Clear concentric striae across subject and upper artwork; smooth printed portrait and species strip; M and large ball visible. Some highlights saturate.
Independent full specimen in sleeve/toploader. Confirms art/body coverage, large ball, faceted rules background and white print exclusions. Sleeve reflections and fine detail loss remain.
Lower-right close-up; strong curved ridges across subject and adjacent background. Lower-right textbox is dark/soft; entire lower surface is not resolved.
Upper-right corner close-up. Header/outer rim ridges and artwork respond differently from printed frame and symbols. Subject dark; incomplete line visibility.
Lower-left close-up. Facet boundaries, large ball rim, left border and art striae visible. Textbox fine ridges partly out of focus.
Upper-left close-up confirms portrait/frame and header placement. Dark art and weak lighting do not resolve every ridge.
Listing claims Poke Ball but image does not reveal its motif or etching. Cannot authenticate the printing from this image; do not use to infer a smooth surface.
Full physical front in toploader; upper etched lines are visible, lower motif is hidden by lighting. Supports upper region only, not complete variant verification alone.
Card back, not complementary front lighting.
Strong near-front directional exposure. Large single Poke Ball, differently oriented body facets, fine art/header/outer-border etching. Fine upper subject detail remains dark and needs another angle.
Card back.

Second oblique front of the same specimen. Confirms ball-region and lower-body facet placement through changed highlights, plus side/bottom ridges. Fine subject linework still mostly dark; extreme right bottom is cropped.

Detailed near-flat front with visible flowing lines across border, uniform and background. Face is quieter; printed header and Supporter rule panel differ. Capture method is not established; this cannot replace multiple directional photographs.
Physical card on easel, but card occupies too few pixels to resolve complete etched linework. Useful overall material/identity comparison only.
Physical full front. Wavy background and border lines visible; character, turquoise frame and typography have different responses. One exposure does not establish complete relief.
PSA slab front reached via listing redirect to product 7074376153. Gold border directional lines and granular field visible; no complementary lighting. Slab glare must not become relief.
Physical front in sleeve/toploader over bubble wrap. Weak blue-cast lighting, insufficient sharpness for etched lines.
Back. Listing/gallery text is not reliable evidence of image contents.
Back close-up.
Full front on display stand, weak diffuse light. Fine upper-border lines visible, center largely unresolved. Seller authenticity is not independently certified.
Top-right close-up. Some edge engraving resolved, background and character still lack directional highlights.
Lower-left close-up. Local border wave/fan engraving and textured Energy fill visible. Do not convert printed illustration edges into height.
Lower-right edge and rule panel. Fine side-border lines faint; display stand occludes bottom edge. Not full lower-region coverage.
Back corner close-up.
Grading-app screenshot, not original high-resolution directional photography. App grade is not physical authenticity or texture evidence.
Grading-app score screenshot, no useful card-surface evidence.
Full regular holo front. Silver rim and art background differ from smooth printed subject and body. Weak light; does not establish etched structure (this printing is not textured).
Low resolution front with uncertain capture method; supporting identity only. Not relief or directional structure evidence.

Physical sleeved front in directional light. Horizontal smooth holo sheet visible in picture background and outer rim. Subject and body retain opaque print; no embossed texture. Sleeve highlight at upper-left excluded.
